purpose: Test whether loading immutable gem products beside exhaustive project remaining, then binding only after remaining and JRuby catalog replay, improves warm active semantic completion without breaching the fixed RSS ceiling.

experiment.baseline: bb4a884 sequential index_configured_gems after remaining/replay; Gemfile roots already available at configure time.
experiment.candidate: prefetch_configured_gem_products (manifest prepare + persistent load/deserialize into Vec<LoadedGemDependencyProduct>) joined with project remaining+replay; bind_prefetched_gem_products only after that join; supplemental project-inferred gems via index_configured_gems.
experiment.method: Same two-project goshposh warm persistent cache, identical profiler args and definition probes, back-to-back baseline then candidate on one machine. Candidate held all loaded products (~303/301) until bind.

decision: Rejected and reverted. Unbounded in-process retention of every loaded gem product during remaining project work preserved exact semantic-result fingerprints, but contended for indexing lanes, raised process peak RSS above the fixed 1.777 GB ceiling, and regressed active project/dependency/semantic readiness by about 22–25%. Do not restore all-product prefetch-during-remaining. A future overlap must bound retained product weight (priority subset, disk-backed reservation without Arc retention, or a measured producer that does not overlap the remaining CPU claim).
